movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Hands connected and hanging by the body or under the arms; Vojvodina grip used in some variants.
movement_profile.footwork: Lateral steps, triple steps, and hops.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Closed or open circle, moving laterally.
movement_profile.partnering: Collective circle; in Malo Kolo, men and women alternate with specific shoulder/back grips.
movement_profile.posture: Upright with hands connected in V or W formation.

signature_moves.description: A basic movement motif used in the Kolo in three steps.
signature_moves.name: Triple step

signature_moves.description: A rhythmic hop performed in place.
signature_moves.name: Hop

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Lively, with some dances starting slow and speeding up.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Lively, often involving 8-measure phrasing that matches the dance steps.
music_profile.sound_description: Lively major-scale melodies often played on the accordion, characterized by rhythmic consistency that aligns with the 8-measure dance structure.

basic_steps: Connect hands with neighbors in a V or W formation.
Move to the right using a triple step pattern.
Hop in place while maintaining the bounce.
Repeat the movement pattern to the left.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners should focus on the lateral symmetry and maintaining the connection with the circle.
